free_text: Deferral is indicated because the patient has a prior positive prostate biopsy, meaning the diagnosis is already established. Although the mpMRI showed a PI-RADS 4 lesion and the PSA density was low (0.08 ng/mL²), the established prior diagnosis prevents a new biopsy from changing the management pathway. The prior positive biopsy status is the critical factor that settles this decision.
